description: Land Acquisition - Pitawala, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division,Matale District, Palali, Wadamarachchi North (Point Pedro) D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders (Nos. 71 and 67 of 2024) directing the acquisition of particular land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, including location, boundaries, and extent. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) and his title, the core content focuses on land acquisition procedures and property details, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
